> This is the most valuable kind of feedback we can get. Even short
> reports are great — partial signal beats no signal. Don't worry
> about polish.

## What kind of project

<!-- Stack, rough size, solo or team, AI tool you pair with, anything that gives context. -->

## How far you got

- [ ] Read the README / a guide doc
- [ ] Ran `context-kit init` on a new project
- [ ] Adopted the pattern in an existing project
- [ ] Had at least one real session using `orient` / the skill
- [ ] Wrote a real handoff
- [ ] Ran `inventory --write` against your project
- [ ] Ran `inventory --check` in CI

## What worked

<!-- What clicked? What did the AI do better with the pattern in place? -->

## What broke or felt wrong

<!-- Friction, confusion, places where the docs claimed one thing and reality
     was different. The more specific, the better. -->

## What's missing

<!-- Things you wanted that aren't there. Or things that are there but hard

## Would you keep using it

<!-- Honest answer. "Yes, with X changes" or "No, because Y" both help. -->
